_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
1/2 6AM- Good Morning Stratton Mountain! Let’s get this Fri-Yay, underway by taking turns down 61 open trails, of which 60 trails took on fresh stripes overnight by our stellar grooming team. Alongside, 12 lifts are set to spin at 8:30am with the possibility of delays due to winds. Early access will be available for First Tracks pass holders through January 4. We have colder temperatures rolling through over the next few days, so be sure to bring your extra layers. Have fun, play safe and I’ll be skiing ya out there!

Colder temperatures sticking around have allowed snowmaking and resurfacing operations to go underway and will continue over the next several days as our team works around the clock to get Stratton looking and riding its best.

The park scene is coming to life with a 13-foot ramp Retro Halfpipe open and firing on East Byrnes Side, alongside 5 additional features to keep the laps rolling. Tyrolinne is also open with 6 features ready to ride.

We are so excited for what’s to come this year and are stoked to kick off 2026 with you! Let’s get it! 

Safety Tip: It’s a Vermont State law to put your bar down when on the lift. Plus it’s a really good idea to protect your head with a helmet! 


Holiday week is in full swing with extended dining hours, live music, and special events keeping the Village looking lively. Check out our Holiday Week Dining, Après & Live Music Guide to see what's open, happening, and where the music is at. There’s something for everyone this Holiday week and we couldn’t be more excited to celebrate with you! Click here to check out the upcoming Events Calendar.

The Coca-Cola Tube Park is open! Reservations are recommended to save your spot while availability lasts. Tubing is available in 50 minute sessions starting at the top of each hour. Book now to secure your tickets! Please read the details and policies prior to purchasing your tickets. Hope to see you there!

Ice Skating is open! Lace up and head to the Mill House skating pond for a day or night of winter fun. Enjoy music and a campfire all while gliding under the stars. Book now to guarantee your place on the ice.

Guided Snowmobile Tours are up and running! Explore Stratton after hours with friends and family on a tour to the summit. Be sure to book your spot now to guarantee your spot.

Stay and relish the Green Mountains! Stratton Real Estate is here to help with all your real estate needs. Make your sweet escape a reality.

Reliable cars are the name of the game; that is why we trust Oliver Subaru and Ford. Made for all seasons and all families, check out Oliver Ford and Oliver Subaru for year-round reliability.

Early season hazards are present—watch for marked and unmarked obstacles and snow bridges over open water. Stay in bounds and never duck rope lines. Visit our safety page for more details.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report: 2026 is off to a great start! We’ve received 13 inches of new snow in the last 24 hours, including 9 inches overnight. Another few inches are likely this morning. Some 8:00 a.m. chairlifts may be delayed this morning as patrol conducts avalanche mitigation. Eagle Express is open for the season, serving Sunshine Bowl, Gary’s Glade, Olympia, and lower Eagle terrain. Sunrise is open to ungroomed terrain only. No beginner terrain is accessible from Moonbeam Express. Apex Express and Sunshine terrain should be considered “experts only.” No matter how tempting, stay out of closed areas and do not duck ropes — unseen hazards exist and you’ll lose your pass for 30 days (at all Ikon Pass resorts). More storms are blipping the radar! Grab your UDOT traction law sticker to skip the traffic line when the clouds unload. Have a fantastic Friday on the hill!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Eli with your 5 am snow report for Thursday, January 1st. Remember the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  

Our Mid mountain base is 17 inches, the temperature is 39 degrees, the winds are 5 miles per hour from the west, with clear skies. 

The Summit base is 28 inches, the temperature is 28 degrees, the winds 14 miles per hour from the west. 

The base temperature is 17 degrees.  

We will be skiing and riding on 19 lifts, 63 runs, and 591 acres on packed powder and machine made snow.  

Wind down your day the Steamboat Way at Sunset Happy Hour, with après vibes, live music, and sweeping mountain views. Tickets sold at the Steamboat Gondola in-person only at the time of the event. 

Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  

If you are thinking of exploring outside the ski area boundaries, and don’t know exactly where you are going, don’t go.  

Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!

_inspectorSnowReport.Report: Thursday, January 1, 2026 8:00 AM -- Happy New Year! A trace of wet snow fell on June Mountain overnight with more forecast to fall throughout the day. All lifts are expected, wind and weather permitting. Have an awesome day and here's to 2026.

1/1/26  1:35 am Update:  Happy New Year from Crystal Mountain! We started off the year with some soft spring like turns mixed with liquid snow for the remainder of the day. Don't forget to join us tomorrow for Avalanche Dog Education Day from 11am-12pm! 

Jumpstart your new year with these new deals! Starting January 1st, we're rolling back the pricing on the Anytime and Mid-week 3-day Passes. Ski for as low as $73 a day! No code needed- but hurry, this deal ends on January 11th. Then, on January 6th, we kick off a full month celebration of our founding year, 1962, with $62 now every Tuesday and Thursday through the end of the month. Midweek deals just got a lot sweeter!

Operation Update: Midway Yurt will be closed for the rest of the day. 

Notes for today:
  1. For everyone's safety, sledding is not permitted in our operating area. 
  2. Ski & ride with care. We know you’re excited, and we are too. Please ride responsibly and stay in control today, especially in high traffic area. Take a momement to to read more on our Mountain Safety page!
  3. Obey all mountain closures. Our team is working hard to open terrain as quickly and safely as possible. Closed areas are closed for a reason, so please keep yourself and our team safe by only skiing in open areas. Entering closed areas will result in pass suspension. Thank you!
  4. Book your shuttle today! The Crystal Express Shuttle is free with a reservation, and runs daily through January 4, and continues on weekends and holidays. 
  5. Parking Reservation cancellations are always required if you're not planning on making it up. This includes for advanced bookings and additions from the waitlist. No-show policy applies. Do your part to ensure everyone has access to the mountain. Thank you!
  6. At this time, paid reservations can only be cancelled by emailing SP+ at  CrystalMtnParking@spplus.com with Reservation #, First Name, and Last Name. The Crystal Mountain Contact center cannot process these cancellations.

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
January 2nd, 6:20 AM
Good morning Sugarbush skiers and riders! Yesterday was an amazing start to the new year with new snow, rope drops, and good vibes. Today's forecast calls for another cold and sunny day, temps of low teens at the base and single digits at the summit. You can look forward to getting down on firm and fast groomers today, along with packed powder conditions as fresh snow has been skied in. Groomers tackled Stein's last night, pushing out snowmaking whales, and over on Ripcord and Cruiser snowmaking will continue.

We have over 400 skiable acres served by 12 lifts and 95 open trails, with 38 of those getting a fresh corduroy overnight. Plus, Village Quad made its season debut yesterday, a perfect spot for beginners looking to practice. Hiking at Castlerock and North Lynx is open from 10:00 AM - 3:00 PM today. Ropes dropped on tons of natural terrain yesterday including Moonshine, Hammerhead, Tumbler, The Mall and more. This terrain is suggested for experts only as base coverage is thin and conditions are variable.

Operations are in holiday hours, which means GMX, Super Bravo and Heaven's Gate will get the party started at 8:00 AM. Followed by all other scheduled lifts at 9:00 AM. The Sugarbush Parks crew has dialed in a beautiful freestyle setup at Mt. Ellen with 15 features and 2 jumps. Plus, Slowpoke and Sugarbear Forest at Lincoln Peak are home to 13 total features, and newly installed side hits!  Join us tomorrow, Jan 3rd at Castlerock Pub for a tasting with Athletic Brewing Company, a great way to celebrate the new year with resolutions in mind. Check out all of our winter events!

Lincoln Peak's uphill evening route and Mt. Ellen's route are open, check out our uphill travel policy for more info. *Lincoln Peak morning route is closed due to grooming*

Bonjour Tremblant!

It’s shaping up to be an amazing day at the mountain!
The weather is very cold, so please be sure to dress warmly and layer up for comfort throughout the day. Our team has been hard at work delivering beautifully groomed slopes, and the skiing is expected to be incredible. Whether you’re skiing or snowboarding, conditions are excellent and the mountain is ready for a fantastic day of riding.

Please note that some chairlifts and ski runs will open progressively throughout the day as conditions allow—thank you for your understanding as our teams work to deliver the best possible experience. Be sure to check the Snow Conditions page regularly for the latest updates.

We look forward to sharing a memorable day on the slopes with you!

Mountain safety tip of the week: Be careful when using the ski lifts.
Knowing how to board ski lifts is essential to ensure the safety of all users.
